items.text: Prompt: Ultra-photorealistic cinematic portrait of a beautiful young woman on a beach at golden hour sunset, exact same face as the reference image — 100% identical facial features, face shape, eye shape, nose, lips, skin tone and texture. Do not alter the face in any way. She has long, wavy, voluminous reddish-brown hair cascading over her shoulders and blowing gently in the ocean breeze, strands catching the warm light. Soft, natural makeup with defined eyes, subtle highlighter on cheekbones, and glossy nude-pink lips. Slightly parted lips, confident and sensual expression as she looks back over her shoulder toward the camera. She is wearing a sheer white open-knit/crochet long-sleeve crop top with large circular holes that reveal skin underneath, fitted tightly over her bust, midriff exposed. One hand is gently running through her hair near her shoulder. Pose: three-quarter back view turning her head and upper body toward the camera, soft natural curves of her body visible. Setting: soft-focus sandy beach with calm ocean waves in the background, distant shoreline. Lighting: warm golden-hour sunset light from the left/back, strong rim lighting and golden highlights on her hair and skin, soft lens flare, cinematic warm orange and amber tones, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh on the ocean and sky. Shot on Sony A7R V with 85mm f/1.4 lens, 8K RAW, ultra-detailed skin texture with visible pores and natural imperfections, realistic fabric texture of the crochet knit, high dynamic range, film grain, photorealistic, masterpiece.

items.author: ElsaSofia__AI
items.text: Video prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the exact identity reference for the female character. Preserve her exact face, facial features, skin tone, eye color, hairstyle, hair length, body proportions and overall appearance throughout the entire video. Recreate the provided reference video as closely as possible in scene order, pacing, composition and visual progression. Duration: exactly 14.1 seconds. Vertical 9:16. CHARACTER: A beautiful professional young woman with long dark brown hair. She wears a fitted black business suit, a clean white shirt underneath and elegant black high heels. She wears a futuristic smartwatch on her wrist. Keep the same character, hairstyle, outfit and watch throughout. ENVIRONMENT: A modern futuristic city outside a large glass-and-steel corporate building. Daylight, realistic pedestrians and a clean urban plaza. SCENE 1 — 0.0–3.0s: A futuristic purple flying vehicle descends from above toward the large glass building. The camera looks upward and follows the vehicle as it comes down toward the plaza. Several people nearby notice the arriving vehicle. Keep the building clearly visible behind it. SCENE 2 — 3.0–5.0s: The purple flying vehicle reaches the ground and stabilizes directly in front of the building. Its mechanical landing components extend downward and settle naturally. The camera moves closer while keeping the entire vehicle visible. SCENE 3 — 5.0–6.5s: The vehicle door opens. A compact metallic staircase extends from the vehicle to the ground. The woman steps out of the vehicle wearing the black business suit, white shirt and black heels. Show both the woman and the purple vehicle clearly in the same frame. SCENE 4 — 6.5–8.5s: The woman stops beside the vehicle. She raises her wrist and looks at her futuristic smartwatch. She clearly taps the smartwatch screen with her other hand. Show a brief close-up of the wrist and watch interaction, followed by her focused expression. SCENE 5 — 8.5–10.2s: Immediately after the smartwatch activation, the purple vehicle begins its transformation. Its large outer mechanical sections fold inward and compact toward the center. The transformation happens visibly on screen. Keep the woman standing beside it and watching the transformation. SCENE 6 — 10.2–11.7s: The transformation completes. The large purple flying vehicle has become a compact futuristic purple backpack with structured mechanical panels and shoulder straps. The woman reaches toward it and takes hold of it. SCENE 7 — 11.7–12.7s: She smoothly places the futuristic purple backpack onto her back and adjusts it into position. Keep the backpack clearly visible. SCENE 8 — 12.7–14.1s: The camera moves behind the woman into a smooth follow shot. She walks away from the camera toward the entrance of the large glass building with the purple futuristic backpack on her back. People remain naturally in the environment. End with her walking toward the building, viewed from behind. CAMERA: Match the reference video's vertical cinematic composition and fast visual progression. Use an upward tracking shot for the flying vehicle, a medium-wide shot for the landing, a three-quarter shot for the woman exiting, a close-up for the smartwatch, a clear mechanical transformation shot, and a rear follow shot for the final walking sequence. VISUAL STYLE: Ultra-realistic photorealism, futuristic technology commercial, cinematic sci-fi fashion aesthetic, realistic human movement, realistic hair movement, realistic suit fabric, realistic metallic reflections, physically believable mechanical transformation, natural daylight, realistic glass reflections, cinematic depth of field, HDR, professional color grading, high-detail 4K/8K, 24fps. STRICT CONSISTENCY: The woman must remain exactly the same person throughout. Do not change her face, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, outfit, shoes or smartwatch. The purple flying vehicle must transform into the purple backpack on screen after the smartwatch activation. No fighting, no weapons, no explosions, no car chase, no extra story elements, no outfit changes, no duplicate woman, no face morphing, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no cartoon effects, no teleportation, no text and no logos. FINAL SHOT: The final shot must be the woman wearing the transformed purple backpack and walking away from the camera toward the glass building, matching the reference video's ending.

items.author: seeksteve
items.text: the midjourney v8.2 image editing update is currently rolling out. spoiler alert: it cooks the entire interface is getting a redesign focused on continuous iteration. and it feels like the company is slowly swatting away objections for using other ai image models. btw: full prompts for the image + edits attached to this post are at the bottom. here’s what changed with today's midjourney image editing update: right away you'll notice that you can now generate and revise an image without leaving your current workflow. 1. editing stays in your face before today, editing in midjourney meant moving everything into a separate workflow and losing the flow. now you can edit from the prompt bar, lightbox, edit tab, or the classic Discord --edit parameter 2. finally use multiple subject references (up to 4 total) v7’s "omni reference" only accepted one image for editing which was extremely limiting. the new v8.2 now accepts up to four. this lets you provide multiple views of the same person, product, or object for better subject consistency. i'll post more examples over the next few days. 3. improved inpainting and outpainting with lots of use cases you can now: - replace products without regenerating the entire scene - change clothing, backgrounds, or other objects - extend square images into landscape ads, or any aspect ratio swap. - create vertical and horizontal versions much more easily 4. reference and parameter time saver before today, creating another variation meant reloading image references and parameters. now the reference images and "parameter pills" at within the prompt bar stay in place. only the text clears out. i'm going to be doing a lot less copy/paste lol. 5. they're slowly making the interface a project workspace midjourney is adding folder groups, saved searches, more persistent settings, gallery filters, and integrated upscale, zoom, and vary controls. the team directs everyone to check the alpha version of the site alpha(dot)midjourney(dot)com and that it'll be changing rapidly as it tests new workflows for the editing model. it looks like they launched early to get user feedback and data so they can iterate and improve. i like that approach. i haven't used the tool yet but just a few prompts and you will see how powerful it is. you can keep it super simple and get great outputs: > original midjourney 8.2 image prompt: "Image of what a whale would look like at the beach if they were made out of individual starburst candies and it was whale, gritty realism, the whale itself is made from starburst candies, the only starbursts in the image are the whale --chaos 10 --ar 91:51 --raw --stylize 200 --profile 5ywa2s9". note: i used style reference image for this, which was a closeup photo of some multi-color starburst with nothing else in the image. > midjourney edit prompts: used the original starburst whale as the style reference image for each: edit 1) pineapple whale: "make it a pineapple whale --chaos 10 --raw --stylize 400" edit 2) coca cola whale: "make it a coca cola whale --chaos 10 --raw --stylize 400" edit 3) skittles whale "make it a skittles whale --chaos 10 --raw --stylize 400"
